summary: EQT Private Equity Co LLC filed an 8-K to report a routine continuous private offering of its shares under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act, relying on Regulation D and Regulation S. Between June 1 and June 18, 2026, it sold 1,449,986 shares for $41.9 million at transactional net asset value per class, with no premium or discount. This is a standard periodic update of unregistered sales and net asset value disclosure, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or strategic event is involved. The filing merely discloses ongoing capital-raising activities and monthly NAV per share.
